subject: Shiny server with two shiny versions for different apps?

messages.author: c0095be04acf40df
messages.subject: Shiny server with two shiny versions for different apps?
parts:
Hello,

I have a question about configuring Shiny Server - Suppose I configure it to host two apps on different ports on my server. This has always worked great - However, suppose one of the apps is fully Shiny 0.11 compatible and the other is (currently) working well only on prior releases. Is there any way to configure the application to pull in a particular version of Shiny that is installed elsewhere on the server? I know by default it reads from the system-wide library. I thought I could maybe specify a lib.loc in the library call within my app, but that didn't seem to do the trick...

And I am aware of the withBootstrap2() solution, but oddly that caused a lot of layout problems when I tried it. I'll definitely explore that more if there's no easy way to do what I'm asking here.

Thanks in advance!

Eric
